facts: Same 250-cycle WAT flags as adjacent cases; title requires all PCIe devices.

original_test_intent.statement: Perform 250 DC reboot cycles and prove every required PCIe function returns after each boot.
must_preserve: 250 DC cycles and all required PCIe bus devices.
unknowns: Private flag mapping, complete PCIe baseline, expected dynamic functions and link criteria.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It assumes the command invokes pciePoll although the exact invocation is indistinguishable from OS Ping and USB cases.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Require WAT scenario proof plus stable BDF/vendor/device/link baseline before executing the 250-cycle DC campaign.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run 250 WAT DC Reboots with Complete PCIe Polling
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify every required PCIe function and link returns to its approved state after each DC reboot.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Pinned WAT/BMC platform with signed PCIe topology and OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Exactly 250 cycles and every required BDF/function, including bridges/endpoints defined in the baseline; hot-plug/optional devices need explicit rules.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: WAT package/flag mapping to pciePoll, DC method, complete lspci/topology/link baseline, dynamic-device allowlist, boot timeout and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: After semantic proof, execute 250 cycles and capture per-cycle structured PCIe enumeration/link-state diff plus boot/BMC/host logs.
revision_candidate.preconditions: No pending firmware/device change; protected credentials and OOB ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Package provenance; exact command; cycle ledger; per-BDF vendor/device/class/link speed/width and AER diff; BMC/OS logs; final state.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: All required functions appear in correct hierarchy/link state every cycle with no disallowed AER/error.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No count-only `lspci | wc -l`, guessed scenario, hidden retry, log clearing or device-baseline substitution.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: PCIe/platform owner approves baseline and campaign.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent runs verified harness; engineer resolves allowed topology variance.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Abort on first policy failure, preserve topology, recover via OOB and do not mask missing devices.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unmapped pciePoll, missing/moved BDF, degraded link, AER, boot/harness/evidence failure.

identified_defects: Command does not visibly select pciePoll.
Device count cannot prove all PCIe devices.
reason_for_change: PCIe enumeration is identity and topology sensitive; V3 rejects both an unproven poll selector and aggregate device-count evidence.
removed_ambiguities: All PCIe means signed functions and link attributes.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 requires proof that the private harness really runs pciePoll and upgrades evidence from a total device count to per-BDF topology/link validation.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently preserved private pciePoll proof, exactly 250 accounted DC cycles, frozen per-BDF hierarchy/link baseline, dynamic-device allowlist, AER policy and no count-only or hidden-retry completion.
